beats.text: In Albania, international tourism delivers 35.92% of exports. In Guinea, just 0.01%.
Foreign traveler spending on transport and lodging gives Albania one of the highest shares.
In The Gambia, visitors generate 30.17% of export income, while Ethiopia collects 29.58%.
By contrast, the USA relies on international travel for only 3.88% of exports.
Nigeria counts even less from foreign visitors, at 0.80%.
Guinea sits at the world's lowest mark, where inbound visitors provide 0.01%.
What share does tourism hold in your homeland?
